snippet.title: Rift of the NecroDancer x Pizza Tower DLC Trailer
snippet.description:
Peppino is charging his way into Rift of the NecroDancer: https://bit.ly/RiftoftheNecroDancer

Get saucy with 4 Pizza Tower tracks in Rift:
- It's Pizza Time! by Mr. Sauceman
- The Death that I Deservioli by Mr. Sauceman
- Unexpectancy, Pt 3 by Mr. Sauceman
- World Wide Noise by ClascyJitto

Coming soon to Steam on May 5th, 2025, and to Nintendo Switch on May 21st!
